title: How SLEDMC Works For Employers
description: Our 8-step employer engagement model guarantees candidate readiness, legal compliance, and seamless onboarding.

steps.title: Employer Requirement
steps.desc: Collect positions, worker count, experience, language, salary, contract type & start date.

steps.title: Candidate Sourcing
steps.desc: Identify suitable candidates from the active SLEDMC Sri Lanka talent pipeline.

steps.title: Screening & Verification
steps.desc: Rigorous verification of trade skills, medical fitness, background & document authenticity.

steps.title: Academy Preparation
steps.desc: Language immersion, European workplace culture, safety standards & job skills enhancement.

steps.title: Employer Matching
steps.desc: Present verified, pre-screened candidate dossiers to employer hiring managers.

steps.title: Interview & Selection
steps.desc: Coordinate direct video or practical trade test selection interviews.

steps.title: Mobility & Documentation
steps.desc: Manage legal work permits, visa processing & document legalization with licensed partners.

steps.title: Arrival & Integration
steps.desc: Support airport arrival, initial housing onboarding, and smooth workplace integration.
